authors: Naghavi M, Libby P, Falk E, Casscells SW, Litovsky S, Rumberger J, et al.
abstract: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease results in >19 million deaths annually, and coronary heart disease accounts for the majority of this toll. Despite major advances in treatment of coronary heart disease patients, a large number of victims of the disease who are apparently healthy die suddenly without prior symptoms.
